description: How many venues in each city have menus Dim Hour can stand behind, counted from one menu snapshot. Every city is listed, including cities with none. Each city splits its public venues three ways, and each split covers every venue once: applicability (food or drink venue, not one, or unknown), source (verified_source, unverified_catalog_link, no_link) and completeness (complete, partial, unavailable, requirements_unknown, not_applicable). structured_content counts venues with verified menu sections; fresh_complete counts complete venues whose every verified menu is 90 days old or less at measured_at. These are counts, not a claim that menus are covered. status is unavailable, with no counts, when the menu snapshot does not match the live catalog; reasons names each city that failed.

city.description: City name or key. Omit for every city.
